params.caption: 🎮 Activision blocks Warzone app used to hunt easy lobbies Activision has blocked the third-party tool Warzone Agent from multiplayer in Season 1. Players were using such apps to find easier lobbies, and anyone who tries to get around the block now risks a hardware ban. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 18:10 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto #Warzone #CallOfDuty #GamingNews
